captions: Every year, the same sunset. The same promise.
“When I'm older.” The years didn't wait.
Five summers. Five Ramadans. Gone, like this wave.
And now you feel too far to come back.
Tonight, you step into the back row.
You don't know all the words. You follow.
Your forehead on the ground. Finally home.
Not next year. Not tomorrow. Tonight.
